Alex P: Quick hand-off — I'm stepping out at 15:30, leaving the afternoon watch to Maya. Things changed since morning:
- Canary for kv-cache (canary-id: canary-77) is running until ~18:00 UTC. Watch /v1/generate p95 latency.
- Temporary alert threshold set to 250ms while canary is live.
- I saw a single pod restart at 15:02; pod came back healthy. I dropped logs in RL-4712.
Maya Li: Thanks — taking over. I'll check latency every 20m and keep an eye on error rates. Do we have a known repro for the pod restart?
Alex P: No repro. Quick log excerpt: `OOMKilled` on `inference-worker-3`, then `kubelet` restarted the container. Full logs linked in the Jira. I bumped replica target +1 for canary to be safe.
Ronit K: FYI — scheduled network maintenance for the Dedicated pool at 22:00 UTC tonight. It should be non-disruptive; auto-fallback routing will be enabled during the window.
Sasha V: If you see kv-evictions spike, ping me and I'll temporarily raise TTL and scale the cache pods. Also, watch for increased tail latency if batching drops.
Maya Li: Noted. I'll mute noisy minor alerts for the canary window (15:45–18:15) to avoid alert fatigue, leaving high-severity ones intact.
Alex P: Left a quick runbook note under /docs/oncall/quick-handoff: steps to check `kubectl describe pod` and `kubectl logs -f` for the restart case.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Maya Li's oncall shift ends at 20:00 UTC. Please hand off 10m before end time.
Maya Li: Will hand off to Ronit at 19:50 if things are green. If anything spikes I'll escalate earlier. :thumbsup:
Ronit K: I'll be on standby from 19:50 — ping me for the handover. One action item: confirm canary rollback criteria in RL-4712 (Alex, can you add the exact p95 and error thresholds?).
Alex P: Added thresholds to RL-4712: p95 > 400ms for 5m OR error rate > 1% for 3m triggers rollback. Also added `kubectl` commands and dashboard links.
Maya Li: Thanks — closing loop. Small FYI: I noticed a minor increase in prefetch misses for embeddings; monitoring only for now.
Sasha V: Cool. If embeddings miss rate climbs >3% let me know, I'll bump prefetch workers.
Maya Li: Acknowledge. Handoff ETA to Ronit confirmed.
Alex P: Thanks team — leaving notes in the thread and the runbook. Safe watch. :wave:
